subject: Emergency: Hotel overbooked some exec rooms — need swap plan and ADA confirmations
body:
From: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@emberhotels.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Subject: Hotel rooming conflict for Nov 29–30 — preliminary list attached

Hi Dylan,

Quick heads-up: during a last-minute corporate pickup we have a capacity conflict for the nights of Nov 29–30. Seven rooms in your contracted block are currently double-reserved in our system due to a third-party booking overflow.

We can offer three remediation options immediately:
- Move 3 rooms to our sister property (Ember Annex, across the street) with a courtesy shuttle (5–7 min) and comp breakfast.
- Keep 4 rooms at Ember Main but offer complimentary upgrades / late check-out for affected guests.
- Split the master bill so that any rate differences for upgrades or transfers are billed to the guest card rather than master.

We flagged two ADA-accessible rooms and one crib request in the affected set — I attached a preliminary rooming list. We do not want to move any VIPs without your explicit OK.

Attachments: rooming_list_v3.xlsx (prelim)

Can you confirm a preference within the next 24 hours? If we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow we'll allocate standard upgrades to limit guest impact but prefer to follow your directions.

Best,
Monica Reyes
Group Sales Manager
Ember Hotels
monica.reyes@emberhotels.com
(415) 555-0128

----

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
To: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@emberhotels.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Hotel rooming conflict for Nov 29–30 — preliminary list attached

Monica — thanks for the quick flag.

A few asks so we can decide:
1) Which specific guest names are being proposed to move to Ember Annex? We need the list mapped to who is VIP (no move), who is ok with transfer, and who requires ADA or a crib.
2) Please hold any upgrades until we confirm. We may prefer a transfer for non-VIP individual contributors and keep VPs at Ember Main.
3) Confirm whether Ember Annex rooms are equivalent in bed type and whether Wi‑Fi / meeting access is identical (we'll need network access for two late-night prep sessions).
4) Confirm whether shuttle schedule will handle arrivals between 10pm–1am for late flights.
5) Master bill: for now assume Redwood covers standard room rates and Nimbus covers any incremental hotel upgrade/transfer fees unless we instruct otherwise; we will formalize billing instructions after we see the affected names.

I need the name-level map by EOD today. Laura — can you mark the VIP list (speakers, execs) and queue any accessibility flags? Marissa — can you loop in TravelOps (BlueGate) to pre-authorize transfers if needed?

D

----

From: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@emberhotels.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Hotel rooming conflict for Nov 29–30 — preliminary list attached

Dylan — attached is the affected-name extract from our system. Short summary: 7 rooms flagged; 2 are ADA rooms (King roll-in), 1 guest requested a crib, 2 are labeled VIPs (Samir Patel and Emma Zhou), and 3 are ICs with flexible arrival windows.

Notes:
- Ember Annex: rooms are slightly smaller but same bed types; dedicated corporate Wi‑Fi SSID and internet speed guaranteed.
- Shuttle: runs on-demand between properties until 1:30am; after that we can arrange car service on the house for arrivals up to 2am.
- We have held the rooms for 48 hours to allow for direction.

Attachment: rooming_list_v3.xlsx

If you confirm the three flexible folks can move, we will execute the swap and send a final master-bill spreadsheet for sign off.

Thanks,
Monica

----

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ops@bluegate.com
Subject: Re: Hotel rooming conflict for Nov 29–30 — preliminary list attached

Team — quick prioritization from my side:
- VIPs (do not move): Samir Patel (speaker), Emma Zhou (VP Product). Both need Ember Main.
- Must-have ADA: Miguel Torres (requires roll-in king).
- Crib: Priya Natarajan — needs crib in same property if possible.
- Flexible: three ICs (Riley Park, Jordan Blake, and Diego Fernandez) — they can move to Annex if shuttle confirmed.

Marissa / BlueGate — please confirm that Riley, Jordan, and Diego have arrivals before midnight; if any arrive after 1am we need car service covered. We also need to confirm that Priya's crib request is honored at Ember Main; if not we will swap Priya with a flexible guest.

I'll stand by for the swap matrix and final master-bill.

— Laura
Director, Events Operations
Redwood Inference

----

From: BlueGate Travel Ops <ops@bluegate.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -0800
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica.reyes@emberhotels.com
Subject: Re: Hotel rooming conflict — shuttle/car coverage and cost split

Hi all — BlueGate here. We confirmed arrival windows: Riley Park (arrives 11:10pm), Jordan Blake (arrives 12:40am), Diego Fernandez (arrives 10:55pm).

Plan we can execute:
- Move Riley and Diego to Ember Annex (arrivals before midnight).
- Jordan arrives at 12:40am; Ember Annex shuttle stops at 1:30am so we can pick him up but if there is any delay we'll provide car service.
- Crib request: confirmed at Ember Main for Priya Natarajan.

Costs: Ember Annex transfer is complimentary for the three flexible rooms. Car service beyond shuttle hours (if used) will be billed to Redwood as incidentals unless you request Nimbus to pre-authorize.

I've attached a simple swap matrix showing which rooms move and the resulting master bill rows. Please review and sign off so we can push changes to the property.

Attachment: hotel_swap_matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Avery (on behalf of BlueGate Travel Ops)
ops@bluegate.com

----

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
To: monica.reyes@emberhotels.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ops@bluegate.com, samir@nlp-labs.com
Subject: Final: confirm room allocations, ADA, crib, and master bill split

Monica — thank you to you and BlueGate for the quick turnaround. Confirming final instructions below (please action now and send final master-bill PDF for signatures):
1) Do NOT move VIPs Samir Patel or Emma Zhou — Ember Main only.
2) Allocate the two ADA roll-in king rooms to Miguel Torres and keep them at Ember Main.
3) Reserve crib for Priya Natarajan at Ember Main.
4) Move Riley Park and Diego Fernandez to Ember Annex (both arrivals before midnight). Provide shuttle pickup and communication to their arrival flights.
5) Jordan Blake arrives 12:40am — assign to Ember Annex but hold car service authorisation; BlueGate will confirm on arrival whether the shuttle can pick him up, otherwise car will be billed to Redwood.
6) Hold upgrade offers until we receive signed master-bill; no guest-billed upgrades without our explicit authorization.
7) Billing split: Redwood covers standard contracted room rates and meeting space. Nimbus Systems will pre-authorize any ad hoc car service charges. Please add billing rows for potential car service and note them as pending.

Please send the final master-bill and the updated rooming spreadsheet to my attention by COB tomorrow. I am attaching the signed master-bill agreement to accelerate — please confirm receipt and action.

Attachments: signed_masterbill_agreement.pdf

Thanks — I will be on-call evening of Nov 29 for any last-minute escalations.

Dylan Brooks
Events Lead, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
(650) 555-0199

--- End of thread ---
